const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboTwin 2.0 blocks_ranking_rgb trajectory (eai-standard/2.1).
+
+Uses only camera observations and the robot's own end-effector telemetry.
+The initial block centers below were estimated from the overhead RGB/depth
+view. TCP heights are measured from the table world frame.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+robot = Robot()
+print("protocol:", robot.spec().get("protocol"))
+obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+# In this convention local +x is the approach axis. This quaternion rotates
+# it downward, so the TCP is 0.12 m below the commanded EE frame.
+DOWN = [2**-0.5, 0.0, 2**-0.5, 0.0]
+
+
+def make_target(target):
+    x, y, tcp_z, gripper = target
+    return [x, y, tcp_z + 0.12, *DOWN, gripper]
+
+
+def send(left=None, right=None, note=""):
+    """Send one EE target row, holding the other arm at its current pose."""
+    global now
+    left_cmd = (
+        make_target(left)
+        if left is not None
+        else [*now[14:21], float(now[28])]
+    )
+    right_cmd = (
+        make_target(right)
+        if right is not None
+        else [*now[21:28], float(now[29])]
+    )
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "ee_pose", np.asarray([left_cmd + right_cmd], dtype=np.float32),
+        video="none", note=note
+    )
+    plan = result.meta.get("plan", [])
+    if any(
+        entry.get(side) != "Success"
+        for entry in plan
+        for side in ("left", "right")
+    ):
